title: Secure a cable in a HUMMEL M20 gland with a 24 mm spanner
instruction: Feed the cable into the box to its sheath mark, tighten the gland through one full turn into the green band, park the spanner, and release both hands.
context: Electricians (O*NET 47-2111.00; 821,000 US employees in 2025) fit enclosure cable glands to keep cable pulls off electrical terminals; City & Guilds wiring training explicitly includes cable glands and grips. This task combines holding cable insertion depth with spanner-driven compression of a gland seal, followed by an axial retention check. The named HUMMEL HSK-K 1.209.2000.50 accepts the specified 10 mm cable.
setup: Open Hammond 1591ESBK ABS enclosure, 190.4 x 110.6 x 60.8 mm, clamped to a bench with two padded clamps. Its near wall at x=280 mm has a 20.5 mm hole; gland axis x at y=15 mm, height 35 mm. HUMMEL HSK-K 1.209.2000.50 is M20x1.5, 24 mm flats, NBR seal, cable range 6-12 mm, listed cap torque 4.5 Nm. Miguelez BARRYFLEX-MAN H05VV-F article 82010312-50, 3G2.5, 10 mm nominal diameter, 200 mm sheath plus 20 mm prepared cores: reference origin (115,15,35) mm, sheath end (205,15,35). Two open cable supports at x=25 and 195 mm, y=15, floor height 29. GEDORE 894 24 /6575570 single-end 24 mm spanner, 215 mm overall, 15-degree jaw set, 9 mm head, 154 g plus a reusable 50 g grip sleeve: jaw centre (205,50,35), handle toward +y, sleeve 165 mm from jaw. Sleeve outer 24 x 60 x 50 mm, fixed with two M3 screws; tool cradle and head rest as dimensioned in the README. Lot B moves only the spanner 20 mm toward -x. A 50 mm witness dial and cap pointer show the green angular sector; video must also show one complete preceding turn. All coordinates are mm above the table, x forward, y left. Lots A/B are averaged; screenshot shows A. Green: 1.25 to below 1.55 turns from reset; red: 1.75 turns. These simulation marks await hardware calibration.
scoring: Each lot: correct bore traversal and sheath at least 5 mm inside, both hands clear and 1 s stillness are required for any credit. Cap below 0.75 turns: 0.25; 0.75 to below 1.25: 0.5; 1.25 to below 1.55 plus the configured brake-work check: 0.75. Full 1.0 also needs the spanner parked and a released-cable pull ramped to 50 N over 1 s, held 1 s, with displacement under 2 mm. At or above 1.55 turns: 0; reaching 1.75 latches the damage proxy at 0. Unknown/mismatched state, wrong path, contact, motion or failed pull: 0. Average A/B. Use side video, turn marks, ruler and spring scale in physical trials after calibration. Turn bands and retention threshold are provisional benchmark settings; the work check uses the configured brake model, not measured tool-contact work.
run_limit: 3,200 steps (160 seconds at 20 Hz) per layout
reset_notes: Ready-made specimens: four HUMMEL HSK-K 1.209.2000.50 glands with M20 locknuts and 1 m of Miguelez BARRYFLEX-MAN H05VV-F 82010312-50 cable; cut four 220 mm pieces, each with 200 mm sheath and 20 mm prepared cores. Three gland/cable pairs support one-time enrollment; reserve the fourth for damage checks. Budget about $195 for specimens, enclosure, spanner, clamps, reusable supports/sleeve and measuring tools, excluding tax/shipping and robot/cameras; itemized in README. Before enrollment, record 10.0-10.2 mm cable diameter, intact sheath, torque-angle and pull measurements; establish first-contact and green/red marks on the exact stock. Between trials: loosen cap to zero/open seal, inspect sheath/seal/threads, restore cable on both open supports and tool on its rest, and check enclosure and sleeve for slip. B moves only the tool 20 mm toward -x. Replace damaged stock. Estimated reset for enrolled stock: 2-3 minutes, not a measured time. Fixture fabrication and enrollment are one-time work; no casting, drying or curing per trial. Current simulation bands remain uncalibrated.
fidelity: True-size 24 mm/15-degree spanner jaw; native brake has 4.5 Nm yield load; cap lead 1.5 mm/turn; four compliant pads approximate the NBR seal. Cable has a rigid 100 mm lead and two 50 mm tail links. Friction, stiffness and turn/damage bands await calibration. Work credit integrates modeled brake load and cap travel, not measured tool-contact work; sheath damage is an angle proxy. Finger actuators: 40 N each. No physical trials or full-score demo.
scores: Scripted demo: A 0.0, B 0.0 (2381 actions each). Dream-1: A 0.0, B 0.0 (2400 actions each; step limit, no abstentions). No full-score demonstration; snug work, retention and hardware calibration remain unqualified.
